title: Kazakhstan Winter Splendour | Group Tour Package
highlights: Make your winters memorable in Kazakhstan as you explore its snow-covered landscapes and enjoy thrilling activities, blending adventure with cultural exploration.
Take the cable car ride and ascend to the third level of Shymbulak Ski Resort to take-in the panoramic views of the stunning Tian Shan Mountains.
Engage yourself in Almaty's rich culture as you explore the vibrant Green Bazaar, known for its colourful stalls of spices, fresh foods, and traditional Kazakh delicacies.
Enjoy a blend of fun and scenic views as you ascend to Kok Tobe, renowned for offering stunning views of Almaty's skyline and an entertaining amusement park.
Embark on a hike through lush landscapes and snowy mountain backdrops, and take a relaxing dip in the healing waters as you visit the famous Alma-Arasan Gorge.
inclusions: Flights included from Delhi to Almaty

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered as a valid address proof.
Carry some local currency Kazakhstani Tenge (KZT), as not all places may accept credit cards.
Modest clothing is recommended, especially when visiting religious sites. It's advisable to cover shoulders and knees.
Kazakhstan is one of the most environmentally conscious regions in the world, so make sure you give importance to sustainable travel practices.
Tipping is not mandatory but is appreciated in restaurants and for certain services.
Thrillophilia reserves the right to rearrange or change the itinerary for reasons that are beyond control like Natural calamity, weather conditions, roadblocks, etc.
Any breakage or damage of any items at the property will be charged at actuals.
Please refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages or drugs as they may result in restricted access to attraction premises.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Begin your winter adventure in Kazakhstan as you board the flight from Delhi to Almaty. Upon arriving at the airport, you'll be driven to the hotel. After you check-in and relax for some time, head out to explore the city at your own pace and see places like the Palace of President Almaty, Abai Square, Zelyony Bazaar, and the Palace of Republic. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Flight - Indira Gandhi International Airport to Almaty International Airport

days.title: Day Trip to Shymbulak Ski Resort | Walking Tour of Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory
days.desc: Get ready for an amazing experience and board the transfer from the hotel to Medeu and Symbulak Ski Resort. Upon arriving, enjoy a cable car ride to the top of the resort and admire the views of the snowy Tian Shan Mountains. Afterwards, you'll be driven to Green Bazaar for a walking tour covering the bustling Green Bazaar and Abay Street, along with a visit to the Rakhat Chocolate Factory. Later, you'll be driven back from Rakhat Chocolate Factory to the hotel for an overnight stay.

Walking Tour of Green Bazar, Rakhat Chocolate Factory & Abay Street

days.title: Almaty Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Kok Tobe
days.desc: Today, board the transfer from the hotel to see some of the famous spots in the city like the First President Park, having the largest fountain in the city. Then, stroll through the market areas of the city like Arbat Street, known for various churches and Central Market, known for various local shops. After that, enjoy a visit to Kok Tobe, taking a fun-filled cable car ride. Upon arriving, enjoy rides and scenic views of Almaty. Later, you'll be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Almaty Sightseeing Tour on a Shared basis
Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty on a Shared basis

days.title: Day Trip to Almarsan National Park
days.desc: Get ready and board the transfer from the hotel for an excursion to Almarasan Gorge. Upon arriving, follow the well-marked trails, passing through crystal-clear streams. Also, take-in the views of the scenic surroundings and admire the flora and fauna of the place. After that, you'll be driven to a Gala Dinner at a prestigious Indian restaurant. Enjoy an array of Indian dishes and the warm hospitality of the restaurant. Later, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Depature Day
days.desc: Wrap up your trip with a heart full of experiences and check-out from the hotel. Board the transfer to the airport to take your flight back home.
